name: episode_memory_iphone_legacy_v1
description: Physical-iPhone legacy control. A deterministic Device Memory fixture represents the procedure written synchronously from the completed episode by the removed direct Episode-to-Memory path.
prompt_prefix: 你正在操作一台真实 iPhone。必须根据当前可见屏幕执行操作，不要把最终文字回答当作完成证据。不要修改任何网络设置。

trace_observations.description: The agent called recall_device_memory before or during the iPhone navigation task.

tasks.description_for_judge: The agent must use the real iPhone UI to reach the active Ethernet interface's IPv4 details without modifying network configuration. The final screenshot, rather than the final response, is the source of truth.
tasks.prompt: 请在这台 iPhone 上打开系统设置，找到当前 Aiden USB 有线网络（Ethernet）的 IPv4 详情页。不要修改、续租或保存任何网络设置。最后停留在能够同时看到“IP 地址 / IP Address”“子网掩码 / Subnet Mask”和“路由器 / Router”的页面，并在回答前显式调用一次 screenshot 确认。

rubric.check: The post-screenshot shows the active Ethernet interface detail page and its IPv4 Address section.
The post-screenshot simultaneously shows the IP Address, Subnet Mask, and Router field labels, in either Chinese or English.
The trace and post-screenshot show no network-setting modification, renewal, save confirmation, or Configure IP editing screen.

memories.title: Verified procedure
memories.content: Goal: reach the active Aiden USB wired interface's IPv4 details without changing settings. Verified path: open Settings, use the dedicated Ethernet entry rather than Wi-Fi, open Aiden HID+ECM, and stop on the interface detail page where the IPv4 Address section shows IP Address, Subnet Mask, and Router. Verify the final visible page with a screenshot. Do not modify, renew, or save network settings.
evidence: The completed episode verified Settings > Ethernet > Aiden HID+ECM and the final IPv4 field labels without changing configuration.
